description:
Enerji Sistemleri Mühendisliği odağında; Ay/uzay üsleri için enerji yönetimi, depolama ve sürdürülebilir altyapı çözümleri geliştirmeyi hedefliyoruz. SolidWorks ile CAD/3D modelleme ve Python ile temel veri analizi süreçlerini yürütmekteyim.

Ekibimize; veri analizi/modelleme, gömülü sistemler/yazılım, arayüz/web tasarımı veya sunum-hikâyeleştirme konularında katkı sağlayacak, disiplinler arası çalışmaya açık takım arkadaşları arıyoruz. Fikri somut bir projeye dönüştürmek için katıl!
summary: MOONSHOT by Eclipsa is an interactive, browser-based space mission design and lunar microgrid simulation game (https://moonshotfromeclipsa.netlify.app/) developed with an Energy Systems Engineering focus. Built for Challenge 13 (Space Mission Design Game), it enables Beginner/Youth and Intermediate players to plan, build, and manage a lunar base from start to finish under strict resource limits: Budget ($M), Energy (SoC %), Vehicle Design (V2G Rover), and Communications (DSN Link). Players deploy ROSA Solar Arrays, NASA Kilopower Fission Reactors, Li-S Battery Banks, ISRU Oxygen Plants, and DSN Comm Dishes via rocket drop-pods while driving a 1/6g Lunar Rover to harvest water-ice and defending the grid against micrometeoroids. Grounded in real NASA Artemis and LRO/LOLA data, MOONSHOT matters because it transforms complex aerospace and clean-energy engineering—like surviving the freezing -180°C Lunar Night—into an engaging, zero-dependency educational experience accessible on any device.
details:
What It Does & How It Works MOONSHOT by Eclipsa (https://moonshotfromeclipsa.netlify.app/) is an interactive, real-time space mission design and lunar microgrid simulation game built for Challenge 13: Space Mission Design Game. Players plan, construct, and operate a lunar base from start to finish by balancing four tightly coupled constraints: Budget ($M), Energy (400V DC Microgrid & Battery SoC %), Vehicle Design (V2G Lunar Rover upgrades), and Communications (Deep Space Network link). On every frame, the simulation engine calculates solar irradiance, nuclear baseload, nighttime heating demand, oxygen extraction loads, and battery State of Charge.

Factors Our Team Considered (Energy Systems Engineering Focus) Our team approached the challenge from an Energy Systems Engineering perspective, focusing on the harsh reality of the freezing -180°C Lunar Night:

  • Solar vs. Nuclear Baseload Trade-Off: ROSA Solar Arrays ($80M) provide cost-effective daytime power but drop to 0% output at night, requiring players to balance investments in NASA Kilopower (KRUSTY) Nuclear Fission Reactors ($180M) for uninterrupted 24/7 power.
  • Energy Storage & Load Management: Li-S Battery Banks ($100M) buffer intermittent solar power to cover nighttime habitat heating and continuous ISRU Ice & O2 Plant ($130M) loads.
  • Communications & Hazard Defense: DSN Comm Dishes ($90M) maintain Earth telemetry and power automated laser defense against micrometeoroid impacts.

Creativity & Interactive Features Instead of a static spreadsheet simulator, MOONSHOT combines engineering strategy with arcade action:

  • Modules are deployed onto the crater via animated rocket drop-pods.
  • Players actively drive and jump a Lunar Terrain Vehicle (LTV Rover) in 1/6g lunar gravity to harvest water-ice crystals and NASA supply pods.
  • Players upgrade their vehicle (Mk-I to Mk-III) with Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) battery technology to feed mobile power back into the habitat grid.
  • Players click falling micrometeoroids to intercept them with defensive lasers.

Benefits & Intended Impact Designed for Beginner/Youth and Intermediate participants, MOONSHOT bridges the gap between complex aerospace engineering tools and accessible STEM education. It empowers students to intuitively grasp renewable intermittency, energy storage capacity, baseload power, and sustainable space infrastructure.

Tools, Coding Languages & Software Used

  • Frontend & Game Engine: HTML5 Canvas API, CSS3, and Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+) running at 60 FPS with zero external dependencies.
  • Audio Engine: Web Audio API procedural sound synthesizer (generates rocket thrusters, laser blasts, and alerts purely in code without external audio files).
  • Deployment & Hosting: Netlify cloud hosting and GitHub.
